column1: # Rows of exactly five tab-separated fields: use, path, token, count, reason.
# A Zig file's sites of a clock read or a sleep (src/rules.zig names the tokens) must equal its
# row. A new site fails the build; a removed one fails until the row is lowered or removed.
# A test never asserts on elapsed time and never waits on a deadline that fails it: the gate's
# tests move the clock they run on (tools/build/run/testkit.zig), and a wait for a process or an
# event blocks on that process or event. A row in a test file is only a fixture that blocks
# until it is killed, or a value used as a nonce.
# Scope: Zig files only. Mojo fixtures under tools/ that hold or sleep (tools/build/tests/functional/mem_cap,
# mojo_aws_client) are outside this lint; they are positive-direction holds or fixtures that block until killed.
